why: Pinned Sonnet completed every paired game but matched random legal play within uncertainty. Extra model capability did not produce a measurable game advantage on this short character-policy screen.
next: Do not run the 30-seed admission suite or train the 30–50M specialist from this result. Run one identically bounded pinned Opus screen; reject or redesign the benchmark if Opus also fails.
limitations: Four development seeds and a 32-move cap are a screening ruler, not the 30-seed admission suite.
The legal-constrained track isolates planning but does not measure raw action compliance.
This result does not establish that all representations of 2048 are unsuitable for language models.
